evidence_slice: Vale of White Horse District Council states that the Milton Park Local Development Order was revised in December 2024 and fast-tracks new developments at the business park to support growth. The adopted Milton Park Local Development Order 2024 is dated 20 December 2024. The Order states that development permitted by it relates only to the area edged red on LDO Plan 1 and the zones identified on LDO Plan 2, and its total floorspace parameter is capped at 390,000 sq m.
